items.name: 바닷속 포근한 인형방
items.prompt: Asset: portrait 9:16 aquarium background for a cozy fantasy collectible game, premium SPECIAL theme named Cozy Undersea Doll Room. High-quality softly painted storybook background, rich tactile fabric textures and warm honey-pink light balanced by turquoise underwater blue. Interior of a completely submerged little doll nursery, not a dry room: visible underwater caustic light ripples across everything, tiny drifting bubbles, blue-green watery depth, a broad arched porthole window on upper back wall opens onto distant coral and kelp in ocean. Rounded cream carved wooden architectural trim, shell-shaped upholstered low bench tucked at extreme left, a tiny warm amber pearl lamp at extreme right, a few EMPTY small rounded display shelves only at left/right edges, blush quilted cushion and folded knitted blanket tucked into bottom corners, a wide soft peach sand-colored quilted play rug on bottom floor. NO dolls, NO teddy bears, NO stuffed toys, NO people, NO fish, NO animals, NO text, NO letters, NO logos. User adds their own dolls later. Keep central 65 percent of width and middle 65 percent of height beautifully OPEN with clear underwater space and softly lit rear wall for player collectibles; keep the lower center floor broad and empty for arranging dolls. Cozy welcoming nursery designed FOR plush dolls but currently unoccupied. Furniture minimal and pushed to edges, no tall central furniture, no clutter. Soft perspective depth, front-facing view, intricate tasteful painterly finish matching a magical underwater aquarium game.
